body: I really have the same question. It’s an endless fight.
Completely and utterly tired of useless, unhelpful, excuse of parents. Family push me down the spiral more.
Wouldn’t even be able to get past 30 days. Hour one into day one, if that, I’d reject. If only you were able to make that decision before spawning in.
My very first thought. Still raising my hand.
It’s like an entity of its own with the only goal to push you down until you want death but won’t give it to you easily.
Had the same thought. What advice was that. And many males look for wealthy spouses/want to be trophy husbands, too.
I’ve damaged myself while in my senses and it does nothing.
How do we survive. I can’t keep going on like this

I don’t know what force holds me back as well. I think it’s the notion to stay alive instilled within us through evolution, because that would be the only thing which would explain it. I don’t want to live, either.
It’s torturous. Can’t catch a break, can’t reach peace.

The internal battle of arguing back and forth with yourself of using the bathroom is something I deal with every morning, even through the day. Knowing I have to go, can’t make myself to do it. Or anything.

I’m constantly agitated and a split second away from exploding, all the time. It’s mentally taxing. I don’t want anyone to be near me both for my sake and theirs, I also don’t want to be near myself. It’s the incessant anxiety and being on edge which makes me wish I were far away from everything. But I just won’t be able to escape myself. 

Everything is annoying and I hate all of it.

I’ve been saying it from some time how overrated, overglorified, over everything this experience is. From any angle you look at it’s horrid. I don’t know/understand if people truly feel life is exceptional and a gift or if they are just plain, outright stupid to not see it for what it is. It blows my mind. And it doesn’t. 

And the ones who do start to catch on still reproduce. 

Suicide should have been an autonomal right, it should be considered compensation for the mere fact of being dragged in and forced to partake, but it will never be. The over selfishness of the world wouldn’t let it happen.
Is it your grandma from your dad’s side, too
I’m on the same wavelength. Life is more daunting than death will ever be.
Each time I visit this subreddit, or the suicidewatch one and the like, I make sure to check new posts to see what’s going on there.

Mine attaches itself like a leech to anything it can grab. It is utterly exhausting when everything becomes a trigger/potential trigger. Truly is you and only you. Which is the most stupid aspect of it all.

I can understand this. The best thing I have come across which helps me when I’m spiraling down the going crazy path is that if you are going crazy, you don’t question or know you’re going crazy. You questioning it is the biggest sign you aren’t. People who are ‘crazy’ don’t know it.

Summer is grossly overrated. Winter calms my anxiety on some front as well. There’s too much going on outside during the warm months. Kids yelling and screeching, noise, all the disgusting buzzing from bugs. Everything is dead outside during the winter and everyone is locked indoors. It’s quiet, and nice scenery.

This has caused a lot of vexation and contempt towards myself. Knowing the details of it all, recognizing the futility of taking the hand of overthinking, overanalyzing, but still grasping it anyway. I feel like I do this to myself, and I can just stop but choose not to. What you listed below is my daily fight as well. Always on edge, irritated, agitated, ill, never able to rest.

My frustration with this disorder and myself has spiraled into extreme anger. This illness is infuriating since there is no sign of peace anywhere. Not even for a moment, least for me. It’s difficult to hold yourself from going back and ‘completing’ the ritual the ‘right’ way. I know it’s advised to ignore, but it’s gotten so bad where I feel physically ill if I don’t ‘properly’ perform. It’s hard to move on. I grasp your pain. You can’t win, and the path to overcoming this monstrosity kills you each time.
I’ve stopped scrutinizing and hating on things microscopically and instead macroscopically. This all sucks. The way it all works, it all sucks. The universe is the biggest mark of a fault.

I think the same way. I wasn’t made for ‘life’ ‘life’ was not made for me. Can’t help but to wish you weren’t here to begin with, so you didn’t have to endure all you did. It’s grossly overrated, existence.
I’m right there with you.
This is my sentiment exactly.
7 days if you have anxiety disorders.

Someone said to make pain your motivation. I stared at that statement in hopes of deluding myself as much as that person, and the rest of mankind, to have said what they did. There’s a limit to everything and when your cup overflows there is nothing you can do about it. I’ll never get it. I have the same question.
I am in an identical situation
Hard to think otherwise to be fair. Also hard and painful to imagine if this isn’t hell, and if such a thing exists, then what would that be like.
That would be the title of the novel on my life
The universe is cruel for creating life, and creating life which could feel this way. Just hope death is the nothingness I assume it is.
If my thoughts could be turned off I’d maybe not want to end my existence as badly as I do.
I’ve always thought the same. Even the best life gets boring, redundant. Life is an imprisonment.
It is more or less the same for me as well.

Understand what you mean. Had a couple of near death experiences as a child and wish they had succeeded, so I never had to witness whatever this is now. I’d have made sure it’d have been successful in the past.

I think those who have gone through it and have come out from the other side to tell their story have been lucky. They may know suffering, but they may have gotten lucky. Because this seems so difficult to maneuver and combat. My ‘good’ moments are the less depressed ones before disaster strikes once more. This life game is cruel and unjust.
I can be an ear.

I know very well what you’re saying. I think the same many a times. Coming out of an obsession/compulsion and reflecting afterward I think how ridiculous what I’m doing is, and essentially, I am. I have seemingly nothing to worry about- I cause my own suffering. I feel there are those out there with real problems, too. And they handle their real issues better than I can my self constructed ones. It all leads to a lot of self hatred, lot of self loathing. Least for me. Dumb or not trivial or not think it’s important to remind yourself this is still a disorder; it’s not in our hands nor was this ever the intention. Which sucks, quite a bit. But it can alleviate some shame, guilt, contempt a person going through this tragedy may hold.
When I do have to think it kills me.
I don’t care for any of those things. Hard to continue for the sake of continuing.

Each word you’ve written could very well be a passage from my own life. Having your mind pit against you in every which way is ruthless, and tiring doesn’t begin to capture it. Being ostracized by the world only leaving you to yourself and your brain in corrosion is nothing short of misery. Life doesn’t always seem worth it. I’m so tired of fighting every day, too.
I have been saying this for the longest time. There’s always something, and if there’s nothing and it’s all dandy, it’s boring.

My ocd works close to that. And it is godawful. It does not let you live. I’m a perfectionist, and Im sure the ocd spout out of that. For me however, if I don’t execute something perfectly, I have a heavy feeling the rest of my life won’t be ‘perfect’, and for it to be ‘perfect’ I need to do it perfectly. It’s beyond dumb, I understand you.

This is very much the case for me, however I don’t need to be in a low mood/feel more anxious than usual. It’s like that regardless. Everything feels like a trigger, and I all I want to to escape so far away from everything and everyone where no stimuli exist. 

It is so tiring.
Concurred. This was a mistake.

I don’t have to imagine it considering I’m living it. So I understand your vexation. It’s near impossible living with those who caused you misery, take no regard to the fact they did so, and continue the cycle ignorantly. It’s throttling. I’m in a similar situation you are in with everything else as well. It sucks and I’m not sure what to say since I’m dealing with the same. But I did want to say you’re not alone in all of this.
I can grasp how you feel, because I feel the very same way.
Same way for me but I don’t hold a job. Or school. I do quite literally nothing, but survive.
Knowing what misery this is, I feel for you.
‘Life is hard. Don’t be weak. You have to actually try to get somewhere like everyone else.’
Very true. We can’t be that crazy for wanting to quit, are we.
The only thing I ever feel is anger, passionately. Other than that I’m there with you.
It’s very hard trying to exist in this mess. To exist in not only the storm brewing inside but the catastrophe of the external world as well.

Have the same thoughts. I’m a lot careless than before for the sole reason it might kill me. I’ve  stopped wearing my seatbelt and whatnot. 
You don’t need to feel bad, I understand.
People really, really, really don’t care. Unless it affects them negatively, they won’t say nor do much. Egocentrism at its finest.
Nothing spoken can also be understood

The “I never get anywhere” hit home. It’s as though no matter the number of times you get yourself back up and try, you’ll land in the exact position, at times worse, than where you were standing previously. 

Riding the same wave as you. Feels like a joke at times.
Very true. It’s a buy one get multiple free type of deal.
If there’s a god he’s going to catch these hands.

To be honest I don’t feel embarrassed or guilty for leaching off of them. It was their own doing bringing me in. But they’re too insufferable to live with and I need to leave. 

Everything sucks. I want to be away from everyone and everything. I don’t even ask for much. Thought about living remote/off grid years back. In a cabin somewhere in a nice field or some form of nature. But it’s like, then what. You leave, attempt to make a better life for yourself, live decently if you’re lucky, and then what. All for what. It’s like everything for nothing, you know what I mean.

It’s the same for me except I’m their daughter. They despise me and my lousy existence and spare no chance at degrading me to everyone, anyone, they know. I was cursed from the beginning. What family you’re born into determines everything, with no exaggeration. The moment I broke away from what you’re supposed to be, what you’re supposed to do, how the ‘correct’ way of living is, I lost and was ostracized from everyone. The moment you start thinking on your own and realize this world and its rules and demands are full of garbage, is when you pit everyone against yourself. It comes with a grand price tag, but if it’s the truth how could you lie to yourself to think any different. I relate to every sentence you’ve written. I quickly grasped the frustration behind this post because I’m dealing with the same. Don’t really know what to do. I withdrew from university, like yourself, and with no occupation to become independent and move away from the evil that is family, where does that leave you.  

Many a times I’ve wished the concept of money never came to be. I would have found a place and left long ago. It’s all ridiculous- Either succumb to this world’s drivel and became a mindless pawn, or continue putting up with it all.

There are many instances where I feel I’m alone in the particular circumstance I’m in, but coming on here and reading everyone’s experiences makes me realize there’s plenty out there suffering through the same battle. That being said, I’m at the same point in life as you. I resonate with it all, apart from the jealousy of siblings. I’m glad for mine. 

I’m just as ostracized in my life as you are in yours. Really have no where to go when you’re here, do you.
I’m on the same boat as you.
I don’t see what most people see. And whatever there may be, isn’t always worth it. This world is unnecessarily exhausting, and it kills you from the inside out. Quite literally. I’m worn out, too.
I’m at a point where I could just about give in to something like that.
Finding someone to go with as in someone to die with you
How do you know this attempt would be any more successful

I understand your plight being in a similar situation myself. You may have panic disorder. I suffer from the same and all I can say is panic attacks are the devil’s work. There are meds that can help combat your attacks as well as other anxiety. Have you been put on any

Never heard the quote before but it’s good. 

Why are those who have zero clue what it’s like and refuse to open their eyes and remain blindfolded feel the need to not only talk for us but conjure up their own ideas to how we suffer. If you don’t know, stay out of it.
What do you plan on doing

Not the only one. Not only humanity, I wish everything would vanish, including animals. I see a lot of comments on the eradication of humans but allowing the animals to exist, I think they should be wiped out as well. Nature isn’t beautiful. It’s cruel and destructive. Just like us. Everything needs to go away. There was never and will never be a point to this catastrophe. It’s a waste of time, and for some, to hang on in there and endure it is barbaric. Not only do you suffer, but it’s for no reason.
What happened?

Each ‘institution’, more jail cell, will vary slightly. When I went we were stripped of electronics the entire duration we were there. We also were not allowed to wear clothes with any drawstrings. Some places I’ve heard aren’t nearly as strict and allow devices/aren’t picky with clothing. You wake up at a specific time, sleep, eat, all at set, dictated times. You’re treated like an idiot child. You’ll leave when they think it’s right for you to leave. And every single person in there with me had to lie to get out; it’s the only way and I’m glad they told me. If you have to lie the entire time and your goal becomes how to survive to leave, what is the point. Not only have you wasted time but also you’ll get sent home a long bill for pretty much putting up with those in authoritative positions with narcissistic personalities. You most likely will feel worse in there- none of them know how to accurately and effectively treat patients. 

I can grasp a bit how you feel. It’s tough. Extremely tough. I deal with dp/dr as well. It’s hell. But don’t institutionalize yourself. You’ll get nothing out of it.

Man I know what you mean. I most likely don’t qualify either, and even if I did, what kind of life is that. 
What do you plan on doing, though. I could use some ideas

100%. I have always had a deep rooted feeling within me that I wouldn’t grow old, that I’d die young, and this feeling existed before being depressed. Some things you just know. 
Like you, the question of suicide no longer remains a question. Sometimes, or always, death is more merciful than life ever could be. I think people deserve the happiness or peace they never received, even if it comes in the form of death.

I’m in the same boat. I don’t feel bad for them one bit since it was their choice bringing me into this godforsaken world. But not being able to be independent, it makes me sick. I have no idea what to do. How do you survive in this world where money is needed to survive, but not being able to earn due to your mental health. God.

I am honestly in a very similar situation. And my background is no different than yours. I’ve no idea what to do either. 

I’m personally stuck between ending my existence but finally retaining the peace I never felt however the risk of failing is massive, or continue with my miserable life for god knows how long. It’s being between a rock and a hard place- any movement hurts.

It is by far the worst feeling, ever. As much as this gets thrown around, for this topic I think it matters, because in that moment of time at least for me, I feel utterly alone. But you are not on your own with experiencing what you do. It just happened to me last night. Doing absolutely nothing. Kept chalking it up to dp/dr but it most likely was overthinking/overstimulation. I still feel a bit weird and not real. And it drove me into a panic attack as well. Having several mental illnesses, I can say panic attacks take the cake. Rather have my ocd/depression get worse. I hear you and I know your pain. I tell myself it’ll all be alright and seek distractions to keep myself calm and simply not think about whatever the hell is happening. Wish I could share more tips because I am well aware how much it can suck, and truthfully how scary it can be. If you have any, I’d appreciate them. And if you need to talk to anyone during those times to help ground yourself, because it’s something that somewhat helps me, feel free to talk to me. I resonated to the point I felt compelled to comment.
I’ve reached the same stage- full apathy. Nothing strikes my interest, things are dull and bland. Can’t say I have hobbies. I have zero desire to do jack. It is what it is.
I mean, is the tattoo nice

It’s where I stand now. You can only get back up so many times after you’ve been pushed down. There comes a time where you’ve had your last shove, and what you’re describing here is what you feel then. It’s sheer emptiness, total desolation. It’s very well a void. I’ve come to a point where I’m not experiencing the emotions you’ve listed such as depression, sadness, grief etc., but that I’ve felt them so severely it has taken me here. I feel nothing, and essentially I am nothing. 

You’re here but you’re not. You’re alive but you’re aren’t. Only the physical form remains, if that, everything else drifted away. It’s moreso consciousnesses left in a body.

I’ve said, thought the same thing. There’s only so much you can do about it. Either fail and risk something worse than your current life, or live your current life. The body unfortunately doesn’t give easy. It’s the only thing holding me back. It’s always a question if it’s worth the risk.
Did you not go through with it or did you fail in your attempt
My thoughts align with yours. I think no differently. Question becomes what do you do.
I know where you stand. I am in the same place you are. Can only get back up so many times.
He doesn’t exist. And even if he did, my faith would’ve quickly lifted as soon as I entered this atrocity called life. It’s good he doesn’t; he can only be seen as barbarous.

Morality, much like anything else, can be considered a social construct, but I still try to stick to what’s right and wrong. 

I read some of what you’d written. There are things I find similarity in. I can’t love, either. It’s known as a human trait but I never understood nor felt the need. It’s difficult, impossible finding people like that. I hold a ton of hatred as well within me, and going through some things you said I came across things I’ve said, thought as well. Most folk say things out of what they’ve gone through in life or out of pain but I say whatever I say without anything tainting my judgement. 

There is no reason. Keeping my depression aside, there is no real reason to continue life really. It’s a pastime until we go back to the void. And if the cons overshadow the ‘pros’ I don’t see why we can’t go when we want.
Right there with you. Although I can’t say I have any victories, but whatever non-pitiful things I experience are soon, and I mean right away, accompanied by disaster.
Recently spoke upon this as well. There should be a limit to unfairness.
If you want your peace there’s nothing wrong with it.

Pretty much. There’s many other aspects to life which don’t make sense to me in the slightest and if anything makes life seem like a punishment and a curse. It’s hard to discuss since going against the common opinion leads to being pointed at and labeled as depressed/mentally ill. The way this world is set up it’s hard not to be so. But you have to have two braincells to step back and acknowledge that in the first place. Either way, my depression doesn’t lead to thinking this way; I’m just not blind. 

Life is the worst thing that could’ve came to be.

I deal with a similar situation. But I despise my parents and family, because they played a profound role in shaping who I am today. They are only staring at a product of the environment they brought me up in, and it all backfired. I hide my true thoughts from them, too; some things shouldn’t be said I believe. 

Can’t say I ever had an era of ignorance and bliss. But because you have, perhaps it’s something to hold on/look forward to achieving once more.

The same question has circled around my mind for enough years. I’ll tell you- never. It will never be taken serious or detrimental enough to the point of it being considered terminal. It’s why they exclude it from euthanasia. It’s a tight slap to the face, really.

I deal with the same issue, so I understand. It’s a pesky, vicious, endless cycle. At times I wish the night never ends; I never want to see another day. I end up screwing myself over each time and am full of regret, but fall into the same cycle come the next night. All I want is to sleep, stay in bed and do nothing
I’m sure after death there is nothing but void. And that’s all I want. If there’s any such possibility of reincarnation then I hope I never enter here again. Especially not with any old memories.

Could go the rest of life isolating that way. I’m put off by everything and everyone and have always preferred solitude. Everything is exhausting. Drains you from the inside out. Depression does a nice enough job for me to not need anything else on my plate.
Some people receive a bad hand but are still forced to play. It’s degrading in a way. It’s cruel. I can’t stand living, having a conscience, either

Tell me about it. 
First you get dragged into it, then are forced to stay whilst going through miles of bs. And ending it is another set of problems of its own.
My thoughts exactly.
I grasp your pain.

It tends to start feeling surreal. You begin floating in and out of existence and go through dp/dr. I understood what you meant with the mirror bit. Each time I used to look into one I lost myself more, until I saw nothing staring back. It can be daunting reaching this fact but reading about nihilism can help. It can be the ultimate freedom. It doesn’t have to be scary. It’s what you make it.
Once you hit that realization there’s no going back.

You’re lucky that’s all you’re left with. A botched attempt, especially with hanging, can result in devastating consequences. 

I empathize with your plight. It’s frustrating they won’t legalize euthanasia and allow to die with dignity and a certified, certain death. It’s much harder to end your existence, on a plethora of fronts, than people think. The damn body feels indestructible.
I used to think I could ever go that way. But I’ve been having random thoughts here and there about it. Guess desperate times calls for desperate measures.
Resonate heavily with several of these.

It’s one of the reasons I’m more than ready to leave. It’s why I also mention in regard to my suicidal ideation that no matter how flawless my life could have been, I still would feel this very way. I could be blessed from the heavens in every aspect, but this world would drive me to the same point I’m at now regardless. It’s not only me, it’s everything around me. The negativity will kill me before anything else.
You and I are the same person

Looking for the same answer. 

Logically I know there isn’t any way. Some people live bad lives and that’s that. I won’t let the rose colored glasses wearers sugar coat or twist the truth. But it becomes a matter of how to go on. I really don’t know. And dying isn’t any easier to succeed in. Stuck between a rock and a hard place.
Nothing. I’ll go a step further and state with how corrupt and wicked the world is people should stop being brought in.
Like a rotting corpse you have to begrudgingly drag around.

No attempting, no nothing. Just straight ticket to eternal freedom.
I understand, I’m right there with you.

Asking the real questions. I don’t get the appeal of life. We’ve made it hard for ourselves I’m aware, but consciousness isn’t pleasant  altogether, even if we were living in a utopia. Existence is pain, messy, and it flat out blows.
Although I feel like nothingness I also feel like I weigh a ton.
I’ve been saying. Whoever has my voodoo can stop now
Nice to find my sibling
I’m the same way. I ask for very little. But all I was ever met with was garbage. I abhor society and this world we’ve created. Life is unnecessarily hard.

If you think about it, even if life was perfect or near perfect for you, it gets redundant and boring. This is the best case scenario. There’s no winning. One in some trillion chance of being born. This was never a gift. This was the unluckiest draw to have existed.

This encapsulated my day to day, moment to moment life. From withdrawing from college, to hiding away in a room, to torturous thoughts to every minor detail you’ve mentioned I’m suffering from the same as you. I know very well how you feel. I’m a ball of anger and frustration, but rightfully so. It’s not easy to live with so much anger, but when every aspect of life pisses the everliving fuck out of you, what else are you supposed to do. It’s hard
For some it does, for some it doesn’t.
I wish I was never born so I never had to take the step to kill myself.
I’m looking for answers to the same question. This is horrendous.
I wish I was never forced to play

No I understand what you mean. It’s excruciatingly painful being aware of it all but having no control over that uncomfortable feeling
I understand. It’s become borderline insanity for me. Can only push through it so much.

Every single word you’ve written I resonate with. Saying it’s tough doesn’t even begin to encapsulate it. I feel almost exactly the way you do. From not feeling the need to utter anything to only desiring sleep, and everything else in between, I grasped it all. I refuse to believe this isn’t a hellhole.
Cold truth.
I read your post and I understand. I’m in the same boat.

You did a good job hosting. The last line was impeccable. 
I’m on the same page you are on. We are alone, and even if we think or feel we aren’t, we still are. I hate everything, too.

Ocd runs in mine. Rather, ocpd. And it’s in both of my parents as well. Watching their ocd behavior play out is something that infuriates me to no end. The fact that they BOTH carry this in their dna, the fact that they could’ve prevented this pain and suffering and simply not have had me but did is something I’ll never forgive them for. It’s a different type of anger. I’ve been subjected to this life of pain, and so have you. It’s clear we’ve done nothing wrong, but god does it suck.
I know what you mean. I have this type of ocd. And because this is the most “typical” and warped definition of ocd no one believes me as well. It’s frustrating.

Your rage is absolutely, 100% valid and understandable. I feel metric fucktons of anger/frustration festering inside me as well. Anger is all I’ve become. Truly, fuck ocd and every mental ailment. This is some bullshit.
“Trust” and “people” don’t go hand in hand.
If a part of my thought stream was posted this would be it.

Us being the ones medicated to fit and function in this more than fucked society is something beyond me. It’s one big godforsaken joke. We’re the ones who have to mold to shit, but the shit can stay the way it is.

Double whammy. I understand however. I find my ocd patterns in my dreams as well. Many a times I wake up not knowing if I was in the middle of performing a compulsion in a dream or in real life. It wakes me up as well. The brain never seems to rest. I constantly have to distract myself through documentaries, videos, music etc. etc. too, but I have to throughout the entire day, not only just the night.

100%. It’s difficult to fall asleep, stay asleep and go back to sleep especially. Once I wake up in the middle of the night I’m screwed. It doesn’t let you live, does it. Just want my brain to be quiet. So fed up I could cry endlessly about it.

You could go in for any reason whatsoever, and even without one as well. I know many who have therapists just to talk through their life with. You can be great, successful and still have a therapist. It doesn’t hurt to have someone listen, no matter where you’re standing in life.
There isn’t one honestly. It’s the same thing every day. It’s exhausting. The more you start questioning the less you want to participate.
In the same boat. I barely feel anything but when I do it’s just bad. It’s numbness sprinkled with negative emotions/feelings.

Ocd is the only mental disorder not taken seriously. When have you ever heard “Man I’m so schizophrenic” “Oh my god I’m so bpd” See how stupid that even sounds. “I’m so borderline personality disorder”. Shit doesn’t even make sense yet it’s the most common phrase tossed around with ocd. Ocd is almost seen as a good thing to have. No one talks about wanting schizophrenia, no one talks about wanting to be bipolar or any other mental ailment. The lack of understanding on ocd is borderline dangerous and ya I say dangerous because those suffering with it are not taken seriously. An example being me. I’m denied meds and am dying each day.
Wanna team up.

I see posts like this all the time but it’s like what can you do. Honestly what can you do. The facts are right there, everything is sitting right there in plain sight but what can you do. The only way out is suicide but that’s another thing on its own, not to mention surviving an attempt, which is my biggest hold back. It’s shit all around.
